note: Section VI, the Works: what has been made of Earth Star. build.mjs renders the shelf and the search index from this file, reads each film's size from disk and the field guide's counts from field-guide/taxonomy.json, and with --images draws every poster (a film's from its own render(t), at `still` seconds). The films are [M]: drawn in code, signed by Claude. The guide and the Blender figures are [D]: designs, not devices. `place: seed` sets a film in the seed row (Section I) instead of on the shelf.
